newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Trading on Dhaka bourse suspended.
newsitem.headline: Trading on Dhaka bourse suspended.

text.p: Trading on the Bangladesh's main Dhaka Stock Exchange (DSE) could not resume on Sunday as hundreds of investors in the kerb market staged a sit-in-demonstration outside the DSE building, brokers said.
"We could not enter the DSE building. Even the DSE officials failed to turn up. The trading may not resume. It looks very uncertain," said a broker.

The investors shouted slogans demanding resignation of Finance Minister S.A.M.S. Kibria for failing to check the fall in share prices. They are demanding immediate government steps to revive investors' confidence.
The DSE closed 48.8 points or 1.83 percent down at 2,618.3 on a turnover of 6.4 million taka on Saturday.
